name: stale_aggregate
description: In the POST /api/orders/:o_orderkey/lineitems handler, a new lineitem is inserted for an existing order but orders.o_totalprice is never recalculated or updated. The GET /api/orders/:o_orderkey handler then reads and returns the stored orders.o_totalprice directly, so after this write endpoint modifies detail rows, the parent aggregate can be stale and incorrect.
